summary: The Village is the only Hearthian settlement in the solar system, located in a large crater on Timber Hearth. It is where the player wakes up at the start of every loop and serves as the tutorial area introducing core gameplay concepts.

behavior: The Village experiences constant geyser eruptions caused by thermal vents forcing water up from submerged caverns.
location: The Village resides within a large crater on Timber Hearth.
The Village was built in an area with heavy geyser activity.
The Village contains the Campfire, Launch Tower, Ghost Matter Field, Remote Control Model Ship, Observatory, Zero-G Cave, and Postcards From Orbit exhibit.
lore: The Village is the only Hearthian settlement in the solar system.
The Campfire is where the player wakes up at the start of every loop.
Slate is at the Campfire at the start of every loop, offering marshmallows and conversation.
mechanics: Launch codes for the lift to the player's spaceship must initially be acquired from Hornfels at the Observatory.
Once acquired, the launch codes are retained across loops, allowing immediate lift access on every subsequent loop.
The Ghost Matter Field at the Village teaches that Ghost Matter is lethal and invisible to the naked eye but visible through the Scout's probe camera.
The Remote Control Model Ship is a scaled replica of the spaceship that controls identically to the real ship without risk to the player.
The Zero-G Cave teaches navigation in zero gravity, lock-on targeting, orientation, and equipment repair.
The Postcards From Orbit exhibit lets the player remotely take photos of Timber Hearth from a satellite camera.
